items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the fine notice
items.quote: Binnen zwei Wochen nach der Zustellung dieses Bescheids kann Einspruch eingelegt werden, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Stadt Musterhomburg (Saar) – Ordnungsbehörde.
items.computation: This is a formal delivery (förmliche Zustellung) via Postzustellungsurkunde; the envelope copy shows the handwritten delivery date '24.11.2026'. For formal delivery, the date written on the envelope is the delivery day with no days added, so delivery day = 24.11.2026 (Tuesday). For a Bußgeldbescheid, the Einspruch period is two weeks after formal delivery (§ 67 OWiG, § 43 StPO), counted under §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB: the delivery day itself is not counted, counting starts 25.11.2026, and the two-week period ends on the same weekday two weeks later, i.e. 08.12.2026 (Tuesday). 08.12.2026 is not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in Saarland, so no shift under § 43 Abs. 2 StPO is needed.

items.title: Pay the total fine amount (only after the notice becomes final)
items.quote: Bitte überweisen Sie den Gesamtbetrag erst nach Rechtskraft, und zwar innerhalb von zwei Wochen.
items.computation: The letter explicitly instructs not to pay until the notice is final (Rechtskraft) and then to pay within two weeks of that. Rechtskraft occurs once the Einspruch period lapses without an objection being filed; the Einspruch period ends 08.12.2026 (see other item), so, assuming no objection is lodged, Rechtskraft occurs the next day, 09.12.2026 (Wednesday). Counting two weeks from that event under §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB (event day not counted, period ends on the same weekday two weeks later) gives 23.12.2026 (Wednesday), which is not a weekend or public holiday in Saarland, so no shift is needed. This date is contingent on no Einspruch being filed and is therefore only an estimate.

warnings: The payment due date (2026-12-23) is an estimate that assumes no Einspruch is filed; if an objection is lodged within the two-week period, the notice does not become final and no payment deadline currently applies — verify the actual status before paying.

The sender's email address 'bussgeld@stadt-musterhomburg-(saar)-o.example' has an unusual format (parentheses inside the domain) and the domain is a placeholder/example domain; double-check the real official contact details of the Bußgeldstelle before using them.

The IBAN given (DE86 5945 0010 0004 2401 00, 'Landesmusterbank') should be verified against the official payment details of the Stadt Musterhomburg before any transfer, especially since the letter itself says payment should only be made after the notice becomes final.
